features.name: Resonant Crystal
features.description:
At 2nd level, create a spellcasting focus crystal. After each long rest, attune it to one harmonic frequency:

- **Clarity:** Advantage vs frightened/charmed
- **Cleansing:** Advantage vs poisoned + poison resistance
- **Focus:** Advantage on concentration saves
- **Healing:** +prof bonus HP when you cast healing spells
- **Vitality:** Grant 2 × prof bonus temp HP to a creature within 30 ft when casting L1+ spells

features.name: Crystalline Skin
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you take damage, use reaction to make your skin crystalline until end of next turn. Resistance to cold, radiant, and nonmagical B/P/S. Prof bonus uses/long rest.

payload.name: Crystalline Skin
payload.description: Resistance to cold, radiant, and nonmagical B/P/S until end of next turn.

features.name: Magical Resonance
features.description: At 10th level, as bonus action, recover one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower from your resonant crystal. Loses harmonic frequency for 1 min. 1/long rest.

features.name: Crystalline Form
features.description:
At 14th level, expend one Wild Shape use as bonus action to assume crystalline form for 1 min:
- Resistance to cold, radiant, and nonmagical B/P/S
- Advantage on saves vs spells/magic
- Benefits of all five harmonic frequencies (choose Healing/Vitality targets per spell cast)
